grader.call_summary: Third call about a modem that never activated after a house move. Kyle troubleshoots blind for five minutes before verifying, never restates the problem, answers two clearly upset moments coldly and leaves the line silent twice. He does find the stuck activation himself, fixes it, credits four days and confirms it works.
grader.criteria_source: resources/criteria_config.json (tenant-abc): 11 items, weights Soft Skills 0.333 / Technical Knowledge 0.667
app_traps: Customer says 'stupid' at 05:27. With the agent-only profanity check this must NOT auto-fail; an app score of 0 here means the fix is missing on that engine.

items.evidence: [00:00] 'Thank you for calling S-Net technical support'; [21:30] survey invitation and 'Thank you for choosing S-Net'.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air

items.expected_app_behaviour: Rule: FAIL (first PIN/address mention is at 04:57, after 240 s).

Can you do it one more time for me?'; [05:27] 'this whole thing has been a nightmare... this stupid modem just keeps blinking at me' -> [05:48] 'Okay. I'm looking at the move order now.' items.name: Paraphrasing

items.name: Active listening
